WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

Requisito: Inglês Avançado.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role -LLM - Full Stack Python + JS

Project duration: 3 Months

Exp - 3+ Years

Skill - Python, JavaScript / Node.js, TypeScript

Availability - 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.


Role Overview :

We’re a coding-focused team at Turing that serves as a research partner for a Frontier AI Lab. Our role is to build coding tasks, evaluations, datasets, and tooling that help train and improve large language models (LLMs).

You’ll write and debug production-quality code, design rigorous evaluations, and build reproducible workflows that generate clean, high-signal data for model training. Attention to detail matters deeply here—small mistakes can cascade into misleading results, so precision and thoroughness are essential. You’ll also collaborate closely with engineers, researchers, and quality owners to align on standards, review work, and continuously raise the quality bar.

If you enjoy solving unusual technical problems, investigating subtle model failures, and working in developer-like environments where correctness, reproducibility, and collaboration matter, this role will keep you very entertained.


What does your day-to-day look like :

  • Write, review, and debug code across multiple languages
  • Design tasks and evaluation scenarios for coding, reasoning, and debugging
  • Investigate LLM outputs and identify hallucinations, regressions, and failure modes
  • Build reproducible dev environments using Docker + automation tools
  • Develop scripts, pipelines, and tools for data generation, scoring, and validation
  • Produce structured annotations, judgments, and high-quality datasets
  • Run systematic evaluations that help improve model reliability and reasoning

Required Skills :

  • Experience using LLM coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, CodeWhisperer)Strong hands-on coding experience (professional or research-based) in one or more of:
  • Python, JavaScript / Node.js, TypeScript
  • (Additional languages like Go, Java, C++, C#, Rust, SQL, R, Dart, etc. are a plus)
  • Solid experience with Linux + Bash, scripting, and automation
  • Strong with Docker, reproducible environments, and dev containers
  • Advanced Git skills (branching, diffs, patches, conflict resolution)
  • Solid understanding of testing and QA (unit, integration, negative, edge-case focused)
  • Ability to reliably overlap with 8am–12pm PT

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Account Executive
description:
About Warmy.io

Warmy.io is the go-to AI-driven email deliverability platform , helping businesses and individuals improve email deliverability and inbox placement. Our technology is trusted by startups, agencies, and enterprises globally to ensure their emails land in the inbox - not the spam folder.

We’re growing fast and looking for an experienced Account Executive who knows how to close deals, build relationships, and drive revenue in both B2B and B2C markets . If you have a background in SaaS sales, MarTech, and a killer command of English , we want you on board.


About the Role

As an Account Executive , you will manage deals from discovery, to negotiations, to closing the deal. You’ll work with inbound and outbound prospects, demo our product, and craft tailored solutions to help customers improve their email deliverability.

This is a fully remote position with a competitive base salary + commission , offering a real opportunity to grow with a fast-moving SaaS company.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle , from initial contact to closing.
  • Conduct discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to convert prospects into paying customers.
  • Work closely with marketing and customer success to optimize the sales funnel.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies for both B2B and B2C clients.
  • Track and manage deals in CRM (HubSpot)
  • Stay on top of industry trends, competitors, and market needs to refine sales approaches.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to improve Warmy.io based on customer insights


What We’re Looking For
  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS sales (ideally MarTech, email deliverability, or sales automation).
  • Proven track record of closing deals and exceeding quotas .
  • Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C sales cycles .
  • Excellent English - you can sell, negotiate, and handle objections like a pro.
  • Experience working with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - you know how to deliver a killer demo.
  • A data-driven mindset - you track metrics and continuously optimize your approach.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission .
  • Fully remote work - flexible, global-friendly environment.
  • High-growth SaaS environment with plenty of learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Work alongside a world-class team in MarTech and email deliverability.

﻿

Ready to join Warmy.io and make an impact? Apply now and let’s talk!

Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) SAP MM Pleno para atuar em demandas funcionais do módulo MM, com foco nos processos ponta a ponta. O profissional atuará no Brasil em modalidade 100% home office, apoiando projetos, melhorias contínuas e demandas funcionais em ambiente SAP.


Principais Responsabilidades

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Consultor SAP Basis


Buscamos um Consultor SAP Basis qualificado e proativo para gerenciar, manter e otimizar sistemas SAP em um cenário RISE com SAP. Esta função exige experiência prática com ambientes SAP hospedados em nuvem, especialmente em plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud e integração com hiperescaladores (AWS, Azure, GCP). O candidato ideal garantirá alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos aplicativos SAP e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com provedores SAP e de nuvem.


Responsabilidades:


  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe de Especialistas do Cliente no escritório do cliente.
  • Experiência com HANA (obrigatório)
  • Gerenciar operações técnicas para SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP BW/4HANA.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Operações de Nuvem SAP, provedores de nuvem e equipes de TI do cliente.
  • Apoiar projetos de migração para o RISE com SAP (integração, conversão de sistemas, atividades de migração para a nuvem).
  • Gerencie a administração de usuários, o gerenciamento de transporte, cópias do sistema, backups, restaurações, aplicação de patches e atualizações.
  • Configure e monitore o SAP Cloud ALM, o Solution Manager ou o Focused Run, conforme apropriado para monitoramento centrado na nuvem.
  • Implemente as melhores práticas de segurança SAP, incluindo o fortalecimento do sistema e as autorizações de usuários.
  • Analise o desempenho do sistema e proponha otimizações.
  • Participe do gerenciamento de incidentes e problemas, análise de causa raiz e monitoramento proativo.
  • Gerencie cortes técnicos para implementações ou atualizações do SAP no ambiente RISE.
  • Crie e mantenha documentação técnica, incluindo runbooks operacionais.
  • Mantenha-se atualizado com as inovações SAP (roadmap RISE, serviços SAP BTP, ofertas de hiperescala).


Requisitos:


  • Experiência como Consultor SAP Basis.
  • Experiência com HANA db. (obrigatório)
  • Inglês avançado

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Engenheiro de Dados III
description:
Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos a procura de profissionais parceiros para contribuir com o Projeto em Dados em um dos nossos maiores clientes!


Requisitos:

• Experiência com data lakes, data mesh e recursos da AWS , incluindo AWS Glue, kinesis, Redshift, Athena, Aurora e S3.

• Capacidade de criar APIs e desenvolver utilizando PySpark no Databricks / EMR.

• Experiência com alocação de recursos em clusters na AWS.

• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de pipelines de dados (Arquitetura Lambda ).

• Gestão de arquitetura de dados (camadas raw, bronze, silver, gold).

• Documentação e transferência de conhecimento dos pipelines desenvolvidos.

• Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban e Lean).

• Habilidades de comunicação , colaboração , resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.

• Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade a mudanças.

title: Executivo (a) Comercial Externo
description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!


⚡ Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil


Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.


A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.


Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui


Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo


Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.


Você será a peça-chave para:


  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.


Principais Responsabilidades:


️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

title: AI Agent Developer Jr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Analista de Automação de IA Jr

Contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mão na massa e experiência prática comprovada em ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
  • Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
  • Aplicar IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Noções de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB).

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About Teachable:

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? As part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

This is a Senior Customer Success Analyst role for someone who operates comfortably without a fixed scope, moves fluidly between strategy and execution, and takes ownership not just of relationships, but of outcomes.


At Teachable, creators are entrepreneurs who build, market, and scale digital education businesses, using our platform as their core operating system. You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. This role goes beyond relationship management: you will diagnose business challenges, form a point of view, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that help creators scale their businesses through product adoption, marketing, and growth strategies.


As our Customer Success model continues to evolve, the scope and engagement approach of your portfolio may change over time. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable operating in this context and adjusting priorities thoughtfully as the team scales.


In this role you’ll:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of high-potential creators, where portfolio size, composition, and engagement approach may evolve over time as our Customer Success model continues to take shape.
  • Be accountable for retention and growth outcomes across your portfolio by turning goals into concrete success plans, defining what “good” looks like for each account, and influencing customer decisions through clear recommendations, follow-ups, and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by diagnosing business problems, forming a point of view, and recommending specific actions related to sales, marketing, monetization, and platform usage. This role requires comfort moving from strategy to tactics (including discussing offers, funnels, launches, pricing, and distribution) and clearly articulating what the customer should do next.
  • Engage directly and hands-on with creators across your portfolio, flexing between high-touch 1:1 support and scalable engagement models as needed. You will help design, run, and iterate on scalable initiatives (e.g. group coaching, campaigns, enablement content) as we continue to evolve our engagement playbooks.
  • Drive product adoption by connecting Teachable’s features and tools to concrete business use cases, helping creators understand what to adopt, when to adopt it, and how it supports their growth.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, PMM, Sales, Support, Data, and Revenue Operations to surface customer insights, align on priorities, and influence decisions that improve the end-to-end creator experience.
  • Actively contribute to the evolution of our Customer Success function by identifying patterns across your portfolio, testing new approaches, documenting what works (and what doesn’t), and translating individual insights into repeatable motions for the broader team.


Must haves:

  • 4+ years of experience owning a book of business in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, with direct responsibility for retention, expansion, or revenue outcomes, beyond relationship maintenance
  • Experience managing a portfolio where growth was not guaranteed, requiring you to diagnose why accounts were plateauing and to take ownership of changing those outcomes
  • Proven ability to advise customers running complex businesses, with multiple stakeholders and unclear paths to growth, translating ambiguity into clear priorities and execution plans
  • Demonstrated comfort operating across high-touch and scaled engagement models, including knowing when to go deep 1:1 and when to drive impact through programs, campaigns, or enablement
  • Ability to develop a clear point of view, challenge customer assumptions, and influence decisions
  • Track record of turning incomplete data and weak signals into structured action plans, and following through to drive measurable business results
  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using customer, revenue, and product data to identify risks, opportunities, and concrete levers for growth
  • Practical experience using CRM and analytics tools to actively manage, prioritize, and evolve a portfolio strategy
  • Fluent in English, with confidence leading both strategic and tactical conversations (all of your portfolio will speak english)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with founders, creators, or entrepreneurs who own both strategy and execution of their businesses
  • Background in growth, monetization, or go-to-market strategy, particularly in digital or SaaS businesses
  • Experience designing, running, or iterating on scaled Customer Success motions (programs, group coaching, campaigns, enablement) alongside 1:1 engagement


You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Enjoy a proactive, growth-oriented Customer Success role , where you go beyond relationship maintenance and actively identify opportunities to drive customer impact
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment , managing evolving portfolios and adapting your engagement approach as customer needs change
  • Prefer working with autonomy and judgment , using your experience to make decisions rather than relying solely on rigid playbooks


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Consultor sênior
description:
Atenção, antes de se inscrever: Se você pretende voltar a trabalhar no mercado financeiro, em instituição autorizada pelo Banco Central do Brasil, em regime CLT, estatuário ou mesmo em conselhos/comitês, esta oportunidade não se aplica ao seu caso. Agradecemos!


· Aposentado ou não, do mercado financeiro (bancos, corretoras, financeiras, instituições de pagamento), que não pretenda voltar a instituições do mercado como CLT, estatutário ou como membro de conselho/comitês e afins

Não pode possuir vínculo de atuação com nenhuma instituição autorizada pelo Banco Central do Brasil

Inglês fluente (leitura, redação, reuniões)

· Sólida experiência, de no mínimo 15 anos, em compliance regulatório e prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro - PLD/FTP (regulação CMN e Bacen), assim como na gestão de projetos nesses temas

· Disponibilidade para atividade em tempo integral

· Deve possuir CNPJ


Nossa atividade:


· Projetos instigantes em bancos, fintechs, instituições de pagamento e demais autorizadas, incluindo clientes estrangeiros

· Horários flexíveis

· Remuneração a mercado

· Trabalho a distância


Escopo de atuação do consultor:


Um consultor sênior de Compliance e PLD/FTP desempenha um papel crucial no cumprimento da conformidade dos regulamentos do Conselho Monetário Nacional (CMN) e Banco Central do Brasil (Bacen), no fortalecimento da instituição autorizada e na elaboração de relatórios e normativos exigidos pela regulação. 


Exemplos das funções que esse profissional exercerá em nossos projetos:


  • Elaboração e/ou revisão de políticas, manuais, procedimentos e relatórios obrigatórios, inclusive referentes a PLD/FTP, alinhados à regulamentação vigente e ao ambiente do cliente.
  • Desenvolvimento e implementação de avaliação interna baseada em risco para fins de PLD/FTP.
  • Verificação da aderência das práticas da instituição ao arcabouço regulatório aplicável, apontando eventuais gaps, oportunidades de melhoria, avaliando criticidade das falhas e vulnerabilidades.
  • Monitoramento e Atualização: o ambiente regulatório está sujeito a mudanças constantes, portanto, o consultor deve monitorar de perto as atualizações nas regulamentações do BCB e garantir que seus conhecimentos de compliance e PLD/FTP enderecem corretamente o necessário.
  • Apoio ao cliente na avaliação crítica dos planos de ação decorrentes de falhas percebidas pela organização ou apontados por auditores e supervisores. Nesse sentido é importante ter conhecimento de causa sobre os apontamentos e disciplina na gestão de projetos, endereçando atrasos e eventuais impedimentos tempestivamete aos responsáveis.
  • Suporte ao cliente na implementação operacional de processos de compliance e PLD/FTP, auxiliando no desenho de governança, processos e controles, assim como nos testes de sistemas.
  • Elaboração de relatórios sobre o objeto de consultoria, com identificação de pontos falhos e recomendações de melhoria.
  • Atuação em projetos multidisciplinares envolvendo gap analyses, implementações operacionais, mentoria, elaboração de pareceres, planos de negócios e trabalhos ad hoc.


O consultor selecionado passará por treinamento com certificação em fintechs.


Remuneração:


O consultor sênior obterá remuneração atrativa, baseada em horas, a taxas de mercado, e poderá auferir remuneração extra no caso de lideranças em projetos e bonificações por avaliação dos clientes.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Gerente de projetos SAP sênior
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos Sênior para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de migração SAP ECC → S/4HANA, assumindo papel-chave na transformação digital da organização. Este(a) profissional será responsável por conduzir projetos de alta complexidade, garantindo a integração entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, o alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa e a entrega de resultados com qualidade, prazo e custo controlados.

É essencial que o candidato possua conhecimento técnico do ecossistema SAP, permitindo compreender impactos funcionais e tecnológicos, dialogar com equipes de migração de dados, Basis, funcionais (FI/MM/SD/BP) e arquitetos de soluções, além de garantir aderência às melhores práticas e metodologias de migração.


Atividades

  • Planejar, coordenar e liderar projetos de migração de alta complexidade no ecossistema SAP.
  • Atuar de forma próxima às equipes técnicas e funcionais, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em planos de execução viáveis.
  • Elaborar, controlar e atualizar cronograma, escopo, orçamento e plano de comunicação do projeto.
  • Planejar e supervisionar as estratégias de migração de dados, desde inventário, mapeamento, saneamento até cargas e validações finais.
  • Coordenar ciclos de conversão, testes integrados (SIT/UAT), cutover e estabilização pós-go live.
  • Identificar, monitorar e mitigar riscos e impactos de mudanças de escopo, assegurando compliance com premissas e restrições.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo alinhamento e comunicação executiva clara.
  • Garantir que o projeto seja executado dentro dos prazos, custos e qualidade definidos, reportando status para comitês e diretoria.
  • Produzir e consolidar documentações de acompanhamento, lições aprendidas e relatórios executivos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Superior completo em TI, Engenharias, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de projetos complexos, com ênfase em migração SAP ECC → SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento técnico do ecossistema SAP, incluindo módulos principais (FI, MM, SD, BP) e integração com áreas funcionais.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas e metodologias de migração SAP (SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW, SAP Data Services, BW/4HANA Transfer Cockpit).
  • Domínio da metodologia SAP Activate, incluindo suas fases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das estratégias de conversão: Brownfield, Greenfield e Bluefield.
  • Experiência em SAP ECC, incluindo entendimento de dados mestres, transacionais e processos críticos de negócio.
  • Certificação em gerenciamento de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP ou equivalentes).


Diferenciais

  • Certificações SAP Activate e/ou SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência prévia em programas de transformação digital envolvendo Data & Analytics, Cloud e Integração com Databricks/Azure/AWS.
  • Vivência em ambientes multinacionais, com comunicação em inglês avançado para reuniões e documentação.
  • Conhecimento em gestão financeira de projetos (FTEs, burn rate, CAPEX/OPEX).

title: Assessor comercial
description:
Assessor(a) de Atendimento Comercial B2C | Afetto Design


Presencial | São Paulo | CLT


A Afetto Design é uma startup do setor moveleiro em crescimento exponencial, criada para ir além do óbvio. Somos uma marca autoral de mobiliário infantil de alto padrão, reconhecida por desenvolver peças que atravessam fases, unem estética, funcionalidade e segurança, e entregam cuidado em cada detalhe — do design à experiência final do cliente.


Desde o início, nossa ambição sempre foi clara: mudar a lógica do mercado, elevar o padrão de qualidade e nos tornar top of mind no segmento. Em menos de dois anos de vida, já estamos entre as 5 maiores marcas do nosso mercado, resultado de visão estratégica, consistência e excelência na execução.


Esse crescimento é reflexo de inovação constante, cliente no centro das decisões, processos bem estruturados e produtos altamente desejados. Mas, acima de tudo, é sustentado por pessoas que entendem que vender bem também é cuidar — e que cada atendimento é uma oportunidade real de gerar impacto e resultado.


Sobre a posição | Assessor(a) de Atendimento Afetto (B2C)


Buscamos assessores(as) acima da média, com inteligência relacional, repertório emocional e fome de resultado.


Na Afetto, vendas são o centro do jogo. Nosso atendimento é consultivo, sofisticado e humano — mas o ciclo só se completa quando há decisão e fechamento. Aqui, não existe atendimento excelente sem conversão.


Você será o rosto da Afetto em cada contato, com papel decisivo na nossa expansão: transformar interesse em compra, dúvidas em segurança e comparação em escolha. Esperamos protagonismo, ritmo, organização e consistência. Se você gosta de metas, performance e crescimento, essa vaga é para você.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir atendimentos comerciais B2C com foco em conversão e fechamento ;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, ampliando ticket médio com soluções completas;
  • Dominar o portfólio Afetto para vender com segurança e autoridade;
  • Conduzir o cliente até a decisão com argumentação ética e follow-up estruturado;
  • Cumprir e superar metas de vendas e performance;
  • Manter organização do funil e qualidade em todas as etapas do atendimento.


Indicadores de Performance (KPIs)


  • Taxa de conversão de atendimentos em vendas;
  • Ticket médio por cliente;
  • Tempo e qualidade de follow-up ;
  • SLA de atendimento (tempo de resposta e retorno ao cliente);
  • Performance individual vs. metas comerciais mensais.


Requisitos


  • Comunicação verbal e escrita acima da média;
  • Forte argumentação comercial e influência ética;
  • Leitura refinada de pessoas e momentos de decisão;
  • Foco em metas, conversão e resultado ;
  • Organização, disciplina e senso de dono;
  • Segurança emocional para conduzir decisões e fechar ciclos.


Informações da vaga


  • Regime: CLT
  • Formato: Presencial
  • Local: São Paulo
  • Remuneração fixa + variável acima da média do mercado , atrelada à performance
  • Benefícios: VT + VR


Perfil Ideal

Na Afetto, vender bem é parte do cuidado. Buscamos pessoas que gostem de vendas , se responsabilizem por resultados e entendam que excelência só se completa quando o cliente decide comprar.


Candidate- se pelo LinkedIn Recruiter e venha crescer junto com uma marca que está redefinindo o mercado.

description:

• Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.

• Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
COMPANY Infobase IT –


Requisitos básicos - DevOps Engineer II – Necessário inglês fluente. Pode estar em qualquer lugar do Brasil e prestará serviços para um cliente da inudstria de turismo e hotelaria, no Canadá seguindo o fuso-horário EST/EDT. Descrição em inglês abaixo. Oportunidades para brasileiros que estão no Brasil ou que possam ter contratos via Brasil.


Faixa Salarial PJ: R$17000 a R$20000 / CLT : R$10000 a R$12000


POSITION


As a DevOps Engineer II, you will be responsible for the infrastructure (on-premises &cloud) supporting all our client´s business applications. You will part of a team with a customer-centric approach and that follows the principles of “Spry – Lean & Simple Technology”. We strongly believe that complexity is the worst enemy and solutions should not be more complicated than the problem they solve.


The role will be working closely with other system administrators, development team and other

stakeholders across the organization. You will be part of the critical incident response team, the on-call rotation team that make sure our infrastructure is always available to our customers 24x7x365


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Overall: Be an integral part of the DevOps and IT Operations Team by managing the infrastructure that support our clients. Reporting to the DevOps Team Lead, the core responsibilities of the position are:


> Customer Satisfaction – As part of our Operations teams, it is everyone’s responsibility

to maintain the satisfaction of our customers by solving incidents in an effective and efficient

fashion, focused on identifying and fixing the root causes of problems. You will be part of an oncall

rotation schedule, requiring you to work flexible hours when necessary to ensure we

maintain our SLAs.

> 50%: Cloud and System Administration – Your primary responsibility is to maintain our

infrastructure (AWS and data centers), including the configuration, management,

troubleshooting, monitoring and/or upgrading of Windows and Linux servers across different

environments. You will be actively managing our applications deployments and will be working

closely with the Developers and Architects in understanding upcoming infrastructure needs.

> 30% Security – While operating our systems, you will ensure the highest level of security and

uptime, taking a proactive approach in identifying and managing cyber risks. You will actively

contribute to improve the Security of our systems by identifying, assessing and remediating any

security vulnerability that could exist. This includes creating, reviewing and modifying SCP and

IAM Policies in AWS, ACLs in firewall solutions, Windows and Linux security settings, among

other technologies.

> 15% AI Adoption – We believe that AI is a set of technologies that empower teams to increase

process efficiency and to offer new product offerings to our clients. Part of your role is to

identify opportunities where AI could help us scale up the value and the positive impact of our

solutions, while ensuring the quality and positive ROI of new tools implemented.

> 5% Learning and Exploring – Everyone in our team is actively Learning on the job every single

day. You are expected to thrive in a dynamic environment where new challenges are

opportunities to learn more about our solutions, customers, and the industry. We value

creativity over strict processes, critical thinking over following strict rules, and value delivery

over busy work. We need you to explore existing or new technologies that creates value for our

organization.


JOB QUALIFICATION – MUST HAVE:

> Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience in

Technology Operations

> 7+ years’ experience in Linux System Administration of physical and virtualized servers (VMWare

and Nutanix).

> 5+ years’ experience in Windows Administration of physical and virtualized servers

> 4+ years’ experience developing with AWS technologies (EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, API Gateway, Cloud

Front) and/or Azure services.

> Strong problem-solving skills, able to troubleshoot and identify root causes to problems.

> Experience with observability, monitoring and alerting tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Nagios,

Zabbix, Splunk, Splunk on-call, AWS CloudWatch)

> Demonstrated ability to manage deployments in the cloud (Terraform, CloudFormation) or data

centers (Puppet, Vagrant, Artifactory, Jenkins, Chef, Ansible).

> Advanced scripting skills (Bash, Python and PowerShell).

> Understanding and acceptance of Agile software development practices.

> Familiarity with repositories (Artifactory, Bitbucket, GitLab).

> Understanding and acceptance that simplicity of our solutions is of utmost importance, this is a

pivotal philosophy at Leonardo.


PREFERRED SKILLS - BONUS:

> Previous experience with enterprise data integration solutions on hybrid (on-prem and cloud)

environments.

> Experienced with AI transformation initiatives including process automation.

> Previous exposure to workflow automation and AI agentic platforms such as Microsoft Power

Automate, n8n, etc.

> Experience with Data Lakehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics) and Data

Visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) solutions.


COMPETENCIES

> Problem Solving

> Teamwork

> Communication skills

> Customer Focus

> Time Management

> Action Oriented

> Planning

> Self-Development


Hiring Process


  • Application via LinkedIn, sending resume in English
  • Screening with Recruiter for 30 minutes
  • 1.5h interview with DevOps Team lead and Vp of Technology
  • Paperwork & job offer

title: Sr. Mobile Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.


Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent-level scoring system—PureScore—continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.


Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces ), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end-to-end automated research solution.


The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our high-impact Product & Engineering team of passionate engineers. You will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining a mobile application. This is a fast-paced role within our global Product & Engineering organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.


The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, and thrives in a collaborative, agile environment. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including product managers, QA engineers, and developers across geographies—to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative solutions.


Your Responsibilities:

  • Build modern, performant mobile applications for iOS and Android using Flutter.
  • Implement client-side data consumption and display for new features utilizing RESTful API endpoints using .NET core.
  • Test drive development and write Unit/Integration tests
  • Design and optimize database structure using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD and cloud deployments.
  • Drive team performance by leading and empowering members to develop and execute innovative solutions.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience with mobile development technologies, ideally Flutter/Dart.
  • Experience with Firebase.
  • Experience of building back-end applications using .NET Core and ORM like Entity Framework (or other Object-Oriented language/ORM).
  • Experience with MVC and MVVM design patterns.
  • Knowledge of C#, Dart, JSON, Git, HTML, YAML, REST.
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3 and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, preference to MySQL)
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Nice to Have

  • Experience in Agile/Scrum teams
  • Comfort with fast-moving teams
  • Comfort with working across time zones and with distributed teams
  • Knowledge of Shell script, JavaScript, and Native mobile development for Android/iOS is a plus.


PureSpectrum Perks:

Join PureSpectrum and become part of our innovative culture (PSX), where we prioritize your professional growth and foster a strong sense of team connection. You'll be part of a rewarding, high-standard environment where team members genuinely enjoy regular celebrations and events—a truly exceptional experience at every level.


PureSpectrum is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited under the law.

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)


Type: Full-Time


About Indigo Beam

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.


Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.


Project Management:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.


Microsoft DevOps Project Management:

  • Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
  • Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.


Business Analysis:

  • Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.


Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.


Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.


Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Informations:

  • Type of Contract: PJ
  • Hours: Full-time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Duration: Long-term
