description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience and deep WordPress expertise to design, build, and maintain scalable, high-quality web applications and platforms. The role focuses on advanced WordPress development, including custom plugin development, hooks/APIs, and database optimization, while leveraging modern PHP and JavaScript practices.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for solving complex engineering problems, improving performance and architecture, and ensuring that all code meets defined quality standards. Working closely with product, UX, and front-end teams, translating designs into performant, accessible, and secure user experiences while integrating WordPress with external systems, databases, and services.

As a senior engineer, you will serve as a subject-matter expert in WordPress and modern web technologies, enforce development standards, and mentor junior engineers on WordPress best practices, scalable architecture, and maintainable code design.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress plugins using WordPress hooks, APIs, and database architecture
  • Implement and extend WordPress functionality while ensuring performance, security, and scalability
  • Develop server-side functionality using PHP and modern PHP frameworks/libraries such as Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symfony, and Doctrine
  • Collaborate on front-end development using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and frameworks such as React and/or Angular
  • Design and implement scalable application architectures, including lar-specific architecture and scalability considerations
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests for PHP and WordPress-based applications, including automated test suites, coverage thresholds, and CI/CD integration.
  • Ensure accessibility standards, security best practices, and compliance across applications
  • Implement secure user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Design, query, and optimize SQL and NoSQL databases in support of WordPress-driven applications


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Experience in WordPress plug-in development, WordPress hooks/APIs, WordPress Databases
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks/libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symfony, Doctrine)
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns and architectural principles (including MVC), front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, LAR), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design and deployment, and authentication and authorization across distributed systems and environments.
  • Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases and their declarative query pages with relation to WordPress
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git, GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with static analysis, code quality, and testing tools used to enforce coding standards, architectural rules, and test coverage (e.g., PHP static analysis, linting, and coverage reporting tools)
  • Experience with Nginix or Apache
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud providers
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits
  • Experience with JavaScript/React in relation to Gutenberg


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AWS-Python Production Support Enginner
description:
AWS-Python Production Support Engineer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Seniority Level

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.
  • Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.
  • Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.
  • Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.
  • Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.
  • Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.
  • Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.
  • Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.
  • Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.
  • Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.
  • Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.
  • Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.
  • Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

  • Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.
  • Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).
  • CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).
  • Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).
  • Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.
  • Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.


Does this sounds like something you'd like to do? Apply and attach your resume in English and we'll take it from here.

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:

A Blue Dot BPO conecta talentos LATAM a operações comerciais de alta performance em empresas norte-americanas. Estamos em busca de um(a) Sales Development Representative (SDR) com inglês avançado, habilidade de prospecção B2B e forte disciplina comercial para gerar e qualificar oportunidades no mercado dos Estados Unidos .

O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração mensal de R$5.000 , com bônus adicionais baseados em performance.
  • Trabalho totalmente remoto, segunda a sexta-feira, das 13h às 22h BRT.
  • Contrato de longo prazo com equipes e clientes dos EUA.
  • Onboarding intensivo de 3 a 5 semanas, com certificações e suporte contínuo.
  • Ambiente profissional organizado, focado em metas e previsibilidade.

  • Inglês avançado (C1) — comunicação verbal e escrita clara e natural.
  • Experiência de 1 a 3 anos em vendas B2B, prospecção outbound, SDR ou desenvolvimento de negócios.
  • Capacidade de conduzir conversas comerciais em inglês com executivos e decisores nos EUA.
  • Organização, disciplina, resiliência e conforto com metas e ritmo acelerado.
  • Perfil tech-savvy, orientado a dados e adaptável.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de vendas e CRMs (SPIN Selling, BANT, Salesforce, HubSpot).


Suas responsabilidades

  • Realizar prospecção outbound (cold calls, e-mails e outreach via LinkedIn) para geração de oportunidades B2B qualificadas.
  • Identificar necessidades do cliente, aplicar critérios de qualificação e registrar detalhes no CRM.
  • Gerenciar pipeline de leads e manter registros atualizados com consistência.
  • Agendar reuniões comerciais para executivos de vendas e contribuir com informações estratégicas.
  • Conduzir apresentações introdutórias quando necessário, com clareza e profissionalismo.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes internas de Business Development e CRM para otimizar processos.
  • Manter um ritmo consistente de atividades e métricas, garantindo previsibilidade de resultados.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo ou LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Histórico comprovado de metas atingidas e consistência em performance.
  • Interesse em desenvolver carreira de longo prazo em operações comerciais dos EUA.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Notebook com processador i7 (ou equivalente) e 12GB+ RAM .
  • Dois monitores para rotina operacional.
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset profissional.
  • Ambiente silencioso e estruturado para trabalho remoto.


Construa sua carreira internacional!


Se você deseja atuar diretamente com o mercado dos EUA, desenvolver experiência executiva e crescer em um ambiente orientado a alta performance, evolução contínua e consistência, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

title: Analista de Dados Sênior
description:
Somos uma plataforma que ajuda investidores a encontrarem as melhores oportunidades de investimentos. Temos como base a filosofia Buy And Hold (Investimento de longo prazo). Trazemos para nossos usuários informações como: cotações, balanços, comparadores, históricos financeiros das empresas, gráficos, cursos, gerenciador de carteiras, entre outras funcionalidades. Lançada em dezembro de 2020, a plataforma vem tendo um ótimo crescimento, mensalmente já são mais de 18 milhões de pageviews acessadas.


Escopo de atividades:


Atuar de ponta a ponta no ciclo de dados: da coleta ao insight, garantindo qualidade, consistência e confiabilidadeDefinir e evoluir boas práticas de tratamento, modelagem, organização e governança de dadosContribuir na escolha, estruturação e evolução das ferramentas de BI, pipelines e organização do stack de dadosTransformar dados brutos em análises claras, acionáveis e relevantes para o negócioConstruir dashboards, relatórios e análises que apoiem decisões estratégicasApoiar a liderança com leituras objetivas, recomendações práticas e foco em impactoTer autonomia para priorizar demandas, organizar entregas e propor melhorias contínuas em métricas e processosContribuir para a criação de documentação que dê clareza, escala e sustentabilidade às análises


Requisitos:


  • Domínio de SQL
  • Experiência com Python e/ou R para análise de dados
  • Vivência com ferramentas de BI e visualização (Power BI, Looker, Tableau ou similares)
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados e construção de dashboards
  • Conhecimento em métricas, KPIs e análise de negócio
  • Perfil hands-on, com autonomia, organização e senso de prioridade
  • Boa comunicação para traduzir dados em histórias compreensíveis
  • Visão crítica e questionadora (“o que esse dado realmente diz?”)
  • Conforto em ambientes menos estruturados e em crescimento


Diferenciais:


  • Vivência em startups ou empresas em fase de crescimento
  • Conhecimento no mercado financeiro ou de investimentos
  • Conhecimento em ETL/ELT, pipelines de dados ou ferramentas como dbt, Airflow etc.
  • Experiência com métricas de produto, growth ou negócios digitais
  • Experiência apresentando análises para liderança ou C-level


Informações Complementares:


  • Ambiente de trabalho agradável e organizado
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto
  • Horário flexível


Salário: a combinar


  • Contrato: Prestador de Serviços (PJ)

Somos uma marca digital estruturada, com audiência qualificada, produtos validados e presença consolidada no mercado. * ⁠Conduzir reuniões de vendas 100% online com potenciais clientes

• Realizar o fechamento de contratos de produtos e serviços digitais

• Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o cenário e a necessidade do cliente

• Seguir scripts, processos e metodologia comercial definidos

• Registrar e acompanhar negociações por meio de CRM

• Trabalhar com metas e indicadores de performance



Requisitos obrigatórios

• Experiência comprovada em vendas de marcas digitais

title: Analista de Segurança Digital
description:
Sobre a ZenoX

A ZenoX é uma empresa brasileira de cibersegurança especializada em Threat Intelligence. Nossa plataforma Vydar monitora e protege marcas e ativos digitais de nossos clientes contra fraudes, vazamentos de dados, phishing e ameaças cibernéticas. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta com inteligência artificial (Tellyu) para detectar e responder a ameaças de forma ágil e eficiente.


Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Segurança Digital para atuar na operação da plataforma Vydar, nossa plataforma de Threat Intelligence, sendo responsável pela análise e validação de incidentes críticos direcionadas aos nossos clientes. Este profissional terá papel fundamental na qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades

• Detectar e classificar ameaças direcionadas aos clientes utilizando a plataforma Vydar da ZenoX e ferramentas complementares;

• Conduzir investigações de fraudes, golpes e incidentes de nível 1;

• Realizar engajamento com atores de ameaças para coleta de inteligência e contextualização;

• Monitorar e reportar novas fontes de vazamentos para ampliar a cobertura de monitoramento;

• Apoiar na revisão e ajuste de Casos de Uso na plataforma, garantindo precisão e conformidade com os contratos;

• Analisar KPIs de qualidade dos Tenants, como volume de ameaças;

• Comunicar descobertas e alertas críticos ao time de Customer Success;

• Documentar análises e alimentar a base de conhecimento da organização;

• Executar rotinas operacionais e playbooks diários.


Requisitos

• Experiência em análise de ameaças cibernéticas, fraudes digitais ou segurança da informação;

• Familiaridade com plataformas de Threat Intelligence ou Digital Risk Protection;

• Capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes para validação de alertas;

• Boa comunicação escrita para documentação e relatórios;

• Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia;

• Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e análise de fontes internacionais.


Diferenciais

• Conhecimento em OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) e técnicas de investigação digital;

• Vivência em operação de SOC ou equipes de resposta a incidentes;

• Familiaridade com Dark Web e Deep Web para monitoramento de ameaças;

• Experiência com automações e scripts para análise de dados;

• Conhecimento em monitoramento de marca, phishing, vazamento de dados e/ou fraudes online.


O Que Oferecemos

• Contato direto com tecnologias de IA aplicadas à segurança;

• Treinamentos contínuos e possibilidade de certificações na área;

• Trabalho remoto.


Modelo de Contratação

• Contratação: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

• Modalidade: Remoto

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English

title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Pipeline Engineer to join our dynamic Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimizing for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Hired individuals will play a crucial role in helping to shape our ETL strategy and be part of a rapidly growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, planning, and implementing best practices that optimize data pipeline performance and reliability across our organization. You will work cross-functionally with all of our product teams to ensure smooth, efficient, and scalable pipelines. This position is ideal for someone who loves tackling complex technical challenges, enjoys hands-on problem-solving, and loves the fast-paced environment where they can make a big impact.


As Our Data Engineer, You Will:

  • Report directly to the Director of Data Engineering, who will provide significant, hands-on training on cutting-edge data tools and techniques.
  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using PySpark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL tooling.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, or in other technical functions.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas .
  • You have a great understanding of working with data, orchestration tools, and data pipelines.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind different data ingestion and delivery strategies.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or equivalent.


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: FullStack Shopify Developer
description:
Crimson Agility is a full-service e-commerce services firm with an in-depth understanding of leading e-commerce platforms and a broad set of design, development, integration, and digital marketing skills. As a company, we promote a culture that values success, fairness, excellence, and professional growth.


Crimson Agility is looking for a FullStack Shopify Developer . The successful candidate will value challenging and innovative projects and take pride in their work. In this role, you will participate on a team responsible for implementing Shopify solutions and developing innovative e-commerce solutions for our clients, following best practices.


This position is available to remote candidates located only within the United States or LATAM.


WE’LL NEED YOU TO

  • Develop and implement innovative features and functionality for e-commerce using Shopify
  • Collaborate with a team of passionate e-commerce professionals to deliver exceptional outcomes
  • Apply your expertise in Shopify, Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and API integrations to extend, enhance, and build great user experiences. For the backend we prefer experience in PHP but other languages like Ruby are also valid.

  • Are looking for a company that places value on training and skills development

IT’D BE A PLUS IF YOU HAD

OUR HIRING PROCESS

Our hiring process is simple but complete and only has three steps:

  • Initial Interview with David Baier (Managing Partner) to check your cultural fit
  • Technical Interview with Ian Coast (Solutions Architect & Managing Partner)
  • Offer Letter

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

description:

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo dos fluxos, desde requisitos e construção até testes, entrega e monitoramento;
  • Realizar e documentar treinamentos, transferências de conhecimento e elaboração de manuais;
  • Garantir a aplicação de padrões de segurança, governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Integrar soluções com sistemas como Jira, Teams, APIs e bancos de dados;

title: Technical Support Consultant L3
description:

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions.   • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software

  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks

  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The Creative Project Manager orchestrates strategic brand and creative initiatives that drive institutional brand equity and enrollment outcomes while maintaining fiscal responsibility for project profitability and creative team accountability. This role combines project management expertise with creative strategy understanding to deliver compelling, measurable brand solutions within the higher education space and consistency across creative deliverables provided by Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Leadership & Brand Outcome Management
  • Lead comprehensive project planning for brand and creative initiatives, establishing clear milestone maps that connect creative deliverables to client brand and enrollment objectives
  • Coordinate Subject Matter Expert (SME) resourcing across creative, content, multimedia, and brand strategy teams to optimize creative outcomes in partnership with Client Operations
  • Proactively assess and mitigate creative project risks, including resource constraints, approval bottlenecks, and brand compliance challenges, escalating issues to the Project Lead or Account Director to ensure proactive resolution and sustained client retention
  • Hold creative teams accountable for brand adherence, quality standards, and deliverable excellence through structured review processes
  • Financial Management & Resource Optimization
  • Track project revenue performance and burn rate to ensure creative projects remain profitable and within approved budgets
  • Monitor creative resource allocation and make real-time adjustments to optimize team utilization and creative project efficiency
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to maintain accurate forecasting
  • Cross-Solution Integration & Creative Workflow Leadership
  • Maintain strategic awareness of creative project integration points across solution project management campaigns to ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints
  • Collaborate with other solution PMs and the Project Lead to coordinate creative asset development timelines and shared brand resource requirements
  • Escalate creative integration challenges and brand compliance obstacles to Delivery Operations team for rapid resolution
  • Participate in cross-functional planning sessions to align creative initiatives with broader client marketing and brand strategies
  • Advanced Workflow Management & Quality Assurance
  • Manage Asana workflows for creative project management, including approval processes, version control, and comprehensive asset management systems
  • Implement and uphold creative quality assurance standards that exceed client brand expectations and industry benchmarks
  • Develop comprehensive creative brief and project documentation systems that ensure stakeholder alignment and creative accountability
  • Facilitate strategic client communications regarding creative strategy, brand development progress, and creative campaign performance insights


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Understanding of brand strategy, visual identity systems, and creative campaign development to guide strategic creative approaches
  • Proficiency with creative workflow management, brand guideline implementation, and creative quality control processes
  • Experience in project management methodologies with the ability to adapt approaches for diverse creative workflows and brand requirements
  • Advanced Asana administration, including creative-specific automation, approval workflows, and sophisticated asset management systems
  • Understanding of creative project P&L management and creative budget forecasting to maintain fiscal responsibility and profitability
  • Knowledge of multimedia production, content strategy, and cross-channel creative campaign coordination
  • Experience with brand performance measurement, creative testing methodologies, and brand equity assessment tools
  • Proven ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while maintaining brand consistency, quality standards, and team accountability
  • Strong collaborator, skilled at aligning strategists and creative teams, fostering open communication between platforms and specialists
  • Dexterity and wherewithal to effectively deal with campaign pivots, platform changes, and continuous optimization requirements
  • Demonstrates initiative and autonomy, effectively managing priorities while utilizing guidance and support when appropriate
  • Experience or interest in using AI tools, with a willingness to learn how AI can impact and appropriately enhance the client experience
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent life/work experience
  • 3-5 years of project management experience with increasing responsibility, including a minimum of 2 years in creative project management
  • Demonstrated experience managing brand, creative, or multimedia projects in professional services or higher education environments
  • Higher education or creative agency experience strongly preferred
  • PMP, Agile, or equivalent project management certification preferred


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Sr. Mobile Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.


Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent-level scoring system—PureScore—continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.


Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces ), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end-to-end automated research solution.


The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a Senior Engineer to join our high-impact Product & Engineering team of passionate engineers. You will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining a mobile application. This is a fast-paced role within our global Product & Engineering organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.


The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, and thrives in a collaborative, agile environment. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including product managers, QA engineers, and developers across geographies—to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative solutions.


Your Responsibilities:

  • Build modern, performant mobile applications for iOS and Android using Flutter.
  • Implement client-side data consumption and display for new features utilizing RESTful API endpoints using .NET core.
  • Test drive development and write Unit/Integration tests
  • Design and optimize database structure using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD and cloud deployments.
  • Drive team performance by leading and empowering members to develop and execute innovative solutions.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience with mobile development technologies, ideally Flutter/Dart.
  • Experience with Firebase.
  • Experience of building back-end applications using .NET Core and ORM like Entity Framework (or other Object-Oriented language/ORM).
  • Experience with MVC and MVVM design patterns.
  • Knowledge of C#, Dart, JSON, Git, HTML, YAML, REST.
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3 and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, preference to MySQL)
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Nice to Have

  • Experience in Agile/Scrum teams
  • Comfort with fast-moving teams
  • Comfort with working across time zones and with distributed teams
  • Knowledge of Shell script, JavaScript, and Native mobile development for Android/iOS is a plus.


PureSpectrum Perks:

Join PureSpectrum and become part of our innovative culture (PSX), where we prioritize your professional growth and foster a strong sense of team connection. You'll be part of a rewarding, high-standard environment where team members genuinely enjoy regular celebrations and events—a truly exceptional experience at every level.


PureSpectrum is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited under the law.

Advogado Tributário Pleno (Remuneração R$4.000)

title: Sr. Salesforce Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to augment the existing team and help accelerate delivery of a critical platform rewrite. This role will play a key part in shaping, building, and stabilizing a new integrated Salesforce-based platform, working closely with internal stakeholders and external partner teams.


Role Overview

The Senior Salesforce Developer will work alongside our partner teams, contributing hands-on to the design and development of the new integrated platform. This is a full-stack Salesforce role, with a strong emphasis on backend development, system integrations, and data modeling, as well as selective frontend work following established UI patterns and standards.


In this role, they will be expected to take ownership of complex features, contribute to technical decision-making, and uphold engineering best practices across a distributed development environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce backend components (Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, async processing) aligned with the ongoing platform rewrite.
  • Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions, including data modeling, integration patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Implement front-end functionality (LWC / Aura) by following existing design systems, UX patterns, and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven patterns where applicable.
  • Collaborate closely with distributed teams, including India-based Salesforce developers and the Brazil-based Astra team, ensuring alignment and consistent delivery.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor less-experienced developers, and promote best practices across the codebase.
  • Ensure solutions meet high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Participate in our partner’s technical vetting, documentation, and formal code review processes.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement during the rewrite effort.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with deep expertise in Apex, triggers, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform limits, performance tuning, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience building and maintaining Lightning Web Components (LWC) and working within established front-end frameworks.
  • Proven experience working on complex, large-scale Salesforce implementations or platform rewrites.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms and migration initiatives (GCP preferred, but AWS/Azure acceptable).
  • Experience working in distributed or staff-augmentation teams, collaborating across time zones and cultures.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.
  • Nearshore location preferred (Brazil, Mexico, Costa Rica) to ensure time-zone alignment.
  • Ability to successfully pass a full technical interview and live coding assessment.


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to Flutter or Go, which may be relevant for future product initiatives.
  • Experience with video/audio streaming applications or real-time collaboration platforms.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Salesforce DevOps tooling.
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architecture Designer) are a plus.


Why Join:

  • Work on a high-impact, end-to-end platform rewrite with a clearly defined launch timeline.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and technical leaders in a distributed, cross-functional environment.
  • Opportunity to influence architecture and engineering practices on a mission-critical system.
  • Fully remote, nearshore-friendly role with potential for long-term engagement and growth.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work on a high-impact, mission-critical platform alongside senior engineers in a fully remote, collaborative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, and maintain high-quality Python libraries and modules used by enterprise clients worldwide.
  • Ensure Python libraries and modules are secure and free from vulnerabilities in both code and dependencies.
  • Define, promote, and enforce Python coding conventions, linters, static analysis, and architectural guardrails.
  • Perform (and lead) code reviews that catch design or performance issues early.
  • Build internal libraries, shared modules, or tooling that abstract common patterns and increase team velocity.
  • Work collaboratively with Product, QA, DevOps, and other engineers to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable implementations.

  • Document high-level architecture, module contracts, and design rationale.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Professional experience (5+ years) with Python development, with a track record of delivering large-scale projects.
  • Deep mastery of Python, including language internals, decorators, concurrency, threading/async, and memory management.
  • Experience designing, creating, and maintaining Python packages.
  • Proficiency with testing frameworks (pytest or unittest), CI/CD pipelines, and package managers (uv, conda, pip).
  • Publications and contributions to open-source Python libraries and community involvement (PyPI).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, system thinking, and debugging large systems.
  • Strong communication skills (verbal/written).
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese - Fluent.
  • English - Advanced.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with asynchronous frameworks, event loops, or systems like Celery, asyncio, RPC frameworks, or message brokers.
  • Experience with Rust and integrating Python with Rust.
  • Solid experience with relational (e.g. PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases, ORM tools, and schema design.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers (Docker), and deployment orchestration.
  • Relevant hands-on experience with automation projects.
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, and fast-paced startup environment.

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

Como Especialista na PrimeUp você:

  • Será responsável pelo diagnóstico, arquitetura de soluções, apoio técnico na pré-venda de soluções, mentoria, participação na execução de projetos, além de liderança técnica e capacitação de equipe interna e usuários;

  • Traduzir as demandas de negócios em requisitos, definindo, projetando e implantando soluções com inteligência artificial;
  • Desenvolver algoritimos criando modelos de tendência com base em um grande volume de dados com a finalidade de resolver problemas de negócio;

title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Pipeline Engineer to join our dynamic Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimizing for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Hired individuals will play a crucial role in helping to shape our ETL strategy and be part of a rapidly growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, planning, and implementing best practices that optimize data pipeline performance and reliability across our organization. You will work cross-functionally with all of our product teams to ensure smooth, efficient, and scalable pipelines. This position is ideal for someone who loves tackling complex technical challenges, enjoys hands-on problem-solving, and loves the fast-paced environment where they can make a big impact.


As Our Data Engineer, You Will:

  • Report directly to the Director of Data Engineering, who will provide significant, hands-on training on cutting-edge data tools and techniques.
  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using PySpark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL tooling.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, or in other technical functions.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas .
  • You have a great understanding of working with data, orchestration tools, and data pipelines.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind different data ingestion and delivery strategies.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or equivalent.


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, and maintain high-quality Python libraries and modules used by enterprise clients worldwide.
  • Ensure Python libraries and modules are secure and free from vulnerabilities in both code and dependencies.
  • Define, promote, and enforce Python coding conventions, linters, static analysis, and architectural guardrails.
  • Perform (and lead) code reviews that catch design or performance issues early.
  • Build internal libraries, shared modules, or tooling that abstract common patterns and increase team velocity.
  • Work collaboratively with Product, QA, DevOps, and other engineers to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable implementations.
  • Profile, monitor, and optimize performance, memory usage, and resource consumption of Python services.
  • Contribute to API design, interface contracts, data models, and integration strategies.
  • Stay current in the Python ecosystem and introduce innovations or best practices where appropriate.
  • Document high-level architecture, module contracts, and design rationale.
  • Mentor development teams via pair programming, review feedback, internal sessions, and guidance.


Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Professional experience (5+ years) with Python development, with a track record of delivering large-scale projects.
  • Deep mastery of Python, including language internals, decorators, concurrency, threading/async, and memory management.
  • Experience designing, creating, and maintaining Python packages.
  • Proficiency with testing frameworks (pytest or unittest), CI/CD pipelines, and package managers (uv, conda, pip).
  • Publications and contributions to open-source Python libraries and community involvement (PyPI).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, system thinking, and debugging large systems.
  • Strong communication skills (verbal/written).
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese - Fluent.
  • English - Advanced.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with asynchronous frameworks, event loops, or systems like Celery, asyncio, RPC frameworks, or message brokers.
  • Experience with Rust and integrating Python with Rust.
  • Solid experience with relational (e.g. PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases, ORM tools, and schema design.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers (Docker), and deployment orchestration.
  • Relevant hands-on experience with automation projects.
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, and fast-paced startup environment.

description:
Role Overview

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for generating qualified sales conversations and pipeline for Exelegent’s 2026 growth objectives.

This role combines inbound lead qualification and active outbound prospecting, ensuring pipeline continuity even during periods of low inbound demand.

The BDR is accountable for pipeline flow, not for waiting on leads.


Key Responsibilities

Pipeline & Prospecting

• Actively generate new sales opportunities through outbound prospecting when inbound lead volume is insufficient

• Execute cold outreach via email, LinkedIn, and approved outbound tools

• Proactively identify and engage target accounts and decision-makers

• Support Account-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives with targeted outreach

Lead Qualification

• Qualify inbound leads according to ICP and SQL definitions

• Validate decision-maker authority, business need, and timing

• Schedule qualified meetings for the sales team

Collaboration & Process

• Work closely with Marketing to align messaging, targeting, and campaigns

• Collaborate with Sales to ensure smooth handoff and feedback loops

• Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline hygiene

• Follow defined outreach sequences and qualification standards


Success Metrics

• Number of qualified SQLs generated per month (inbound + outbound)

• Consistency of pipeline flow regardless of inbound volume

• Meeting-to-opportunity conversion rate

• Pipeline value influenced or created

• Accuracy and completeness of CRM data


Required Qualifications

• 1–3 years of experience in outbound sales or business development (B2B)

• Proven experience with cold email and LinkedIn prospecting

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

• Ability to work with structured ICP and qualification frameworks

• Comfortable operating in a performance-driven, remote environment


Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling B2B services, technology, or SaaS

• Familiarity with outbound and CRM tools (e.g., Apollo, Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)

• Exposure to mid-market or enterprise sales motions

• Experience supporting ABM or targeted account strategies


Working Style & Expectations

• Proactive and self-directed

• Comfortable switching between inbound qualification and outbound prospecting

• Results-oriented, not activity-driven

• Strong discipline in follow-ups and documentation


Why Join Exelegent

• Clear expectations and measurable impact on revenue

• Opportunity to work with enterprise and mid-market accounts

• Structured processes combined with autonomy

• Direct contribution to pipeline and growth initiatives

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to the CEO


Role Details

  • Full-Time
  • Remote Position
  • Working U.S. Central or Eastern time zone hours
  • Join the elite 2X team
  • Work directly with the Founder / CEO


About the Company

2X helps entrepreneurs transform how they run and scale their businesses. We have been in business for eight years, and are now expanding. 


We operate a portfolio of online companies (including Operations.com) that coach high performing founders to step out of day to day delivery and into their zone of genius. Our work gives founders leverage, clarity, and time freedom while driving faster and easier growth. We move with speed, focus on results, and care deeply about doing world class work that impacts real people and families around the world.


The Role Mission

This role exists to protect the CEO’s time, increase execution speed, and turn bold ideas into finished outcomes. As Executive Assistant to Austin Netzley, you will operate as a true right hand. You will anticipate needs, own systems, and create leverage so the CEO can stay focused on the highest impact priorities across the business and life.


What You Will Own

This is a high trust, high responsibility role. You are not waiting for instructions. You are proactively creating order, momentum, and clarity across business and personal priorities.

  • End to end CEO support across business and personal admin
  • Calendar control and priority management
  • Communication flow across email, Slack, and social
  • Research, preparation, and follow through on various initiatives you're supporting


Role Responsibilities

The core responsibilities of this role are:

#1: Business Admin

  • Conducting and handling efficiently email/social communications
  • Handling calendar and event scheduling efficiently
  • Executing timely research requests 
  • Providing support on needed slide decks
  • Travel related support and coordination

#2: Personal Admin

  • Handling, booking and confirming personal travel
  • Scheduling personal events
  • Researching and handling the purchase of personal gifts
  • Personal health related tasks: scheduling appointments, insurance requests, etc.

#3: Marketing Support (for Austin)

  • Potential: Manual social media posting 
  • Providing podcast support (communications)

#4: Mastermind Event Coordinator (supporting our 3x/yr in-person events)

  • Coordinating food and activities for these events
  • Upholding relevant communications (e.g., client, speaker, vendors, etc.)

#5: Team+Culture Support

  • Culture & team communication support
  • Team reports and tracking
  • Planning and coordinating team gifts
  • Handling new hire onboarding and access to systems


You Are A Fit If...

This role is for someone who thrives in fast moving environments and wants to be a true operator.

  • You have prior experience as an Executive Assistant
  • You learn quickly and figure things out without hand holding
  • You are highly organized and detail oriented
  • You take initiative and follow through without reminders
  • You communicate clearly in writing and verbally
  • You protect leadership time like it is your own
  • You move fast while maintaining quality
  • You are tech savvy and comfortable learning new tools
  • You use AI tools like ChatGPT to increase output
  • You take feedback well and improve quickly
  • You bring a positive, growth oriented mindset


What Success Looks Like

In this role, success is visible and measurable.

  • The CEO’s calendar reflects true priorities
  • Communication is organized, timely, and proactive
  • Projects move forward without bottlenecks
  • Events and initiatives run smoothly
  • The team feels supported and aligned
  • Austin has more focus, leverage, and space to lead


Why This Role Is Great

This is not a passive assistant role. It is a seat at the table.

  • Direct access to a high performing CEO
  • Learn more than you ever have in your career
  • Get involved in various tasks to keep things exciting
  • Exposure to multiple growing online businesses (and entrepreneurs)
  • Opportunity to grow with the company long term
  • Fast paced environment where your work truly matters


Tools You Will Use

We will train you on anything and everything, but here are some of the tools we use daily:

  • Google Workspace
  • ClickUp
  • Slack
  • Instagram and LinkedIn
  • ChatGPT and AI tools
  • GoHighLevel (CRM)


Logistics and Compensation

This role is built for someone ready to fully step in.

  • Remote role
  • Full time
  • Working Central or Eastern US time zone hours
  • Monthly compensation between $1800 and $2500 depending on experience
  • Start date by the end of January


If you meet the bar and want to operate as a true right hand, apply now.


I'd love to partner with you for this key role to help you grow, and us grow together!

É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Tech Lead - Plataforma e SRE

contratação CLT


Gosta de desafios técnicos de alta complexidade, arquitetura escalável e resolver problemas de infraestrutura em escala? Aqui você vai liderar tecnicamente soluções em Kubernetes, observabilidade de ponta, automação e práticas modernas de SRE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance dos nossos sistemas.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Liderar tecnicamente a arquitetura e evolução da plataforma, definindo padrões e boas práticas de SRE e DevOps.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade em ambientes cloud e híbridos.
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de CI/CD, automação e Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Estabelecer práticas de observabilidade, definir SLOs e implementar monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OpenTelemetry).
  • Otimizar performance, reduzir MTTR e atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos com análise de causa raiz.
  • Automatizar processos operacionais e de infraestrutura (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Assegurar práticas de DevSecOps, implementando segurança desde o desenvolvimento até a produção.
  • Disseminar conhecimento técnico e promover boas práticas no time através de code reviews, RFCs e documentação técnica.
  • Gerenciar custos e otimizar recursos na nuvem.


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Experiência sólida com práticas de SRE e alta disponibilidade.
  • Experiência avançada em Cloud (AWS, OCI ou multi-cloud) e ambientes híbridos.
  • Experiência avançada com Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Domínio de Kubernetes, containers e orquestração (Docker, Helm, etc.).
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible ou similares).
  • Experiência com CI/CD moderno (GitLab, ArgoCD, Jenkins ou similares).
  • Forte conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel, ELK).
  • Automação e scripting avançado (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell).
  • Práticas de DevSecOps e segurança em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas de alto impacto e arquiteturais.
  • Comunicação técnica eficaz para interação com times multidisciplinares.
  • Perfil analítico e resolutivo para troubleshooting e otimização de sistemas complexos.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering e testes de resiliência.
  • Vivência com FinOps e otimização de custos na nuvem.

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
COMPANY Infobase IT –


Requisitos básicos - DevOps Engineer II – Necessário inglês fluente. Pode estar em qualquer lugar do Brasil e prestará serviços para um cliente da inudstria de turismo e hotelaria, no Canadá seguindo o fuso-horário EST/EDT. Descrição em inglês abaixo. Oportunidades para brasileiros que estão no Brasil ou que possam ter contratos via Brasil.


Faixa Salarial PJ: R$17000 a R$20000 / CLT : R$10000 a R$12000


POSITION


As a DevOps Engineer II, you will be responsible for the infrastructure (on-premises &cloud) supporting all our client´s business applications. You will part of a team with a customer-centric approach and that follows the principles of “Spry – Lean & Simple Technology”. We strongly believe that complexity is the worst enemy and solutions should not be more complicated than the problem they solve.


The role will be working closely with other system administrators, development team and other

stakeholders across the organization. You will be part of the critical incident response team, the on-call rotation team that make sure our infrastructure is always available to our customers 24x7x365


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Overall: Be an integral part of the DevOps and IT Operations Team by managing the infrastructure that support our clients. Reporting to the DevOps Team Lead, the core responsibilities of the position are:


> Customer Satisfaction – As part of our Operations teams, it is everyone’s responsibility

to maintain the satisfaction of our customers by solving incidents in an effective and efficient

fashion, focused on identifying and fixing the root causes of problems. You will be part of an oncall

rotation schedule, requiring you to work flexible hours when necessary to ensure we

maintain our SLAs.

> 50%: Cloud and System Administration – Your primary responsibility is to maintain our

infrastructure (AWS and data centers), including the configuration, management,

troubleshooting, monitoring and/or upgrading of Windows and Linux servers across different

environments. You will be actively managing our applications deployments and will be working

closely with the Developers and Architects in understanding upcoming infrastructure needs.

> 30% Security – While operating our systems, you will ensure the highest level of security and

uptime, taking a proactive approach in identifying and managing cyber risks. You will actively

contribute to improve the Security of our systems by identifying, assessing and remediating any

security vulnerability that could exist. This includes creating, reviewing and modifying SCP and

IAM Policies in AWS, ACLs in firewall solutions, Windows and Linux security settings, among

other technologies.

> 15% AI Adoption – We believe that AI is a set of technologies that empower teams to increase

process efficiency and to offer new product offerings to our clients. Part of your role is to

identify opportunities where AI could help us scale up the value and the positive impact of our

solutions, while ensuring the quality and positive ROI of new tools implemented.

> 5% Learning and Exploring – Everyone in our team is actively Learning on the job every single

day. You are expected to thrive in a dynamic environment where new challenges are

opportunities to learn more about our solutions, customers, and the industry. We value

creativity over strict processes, critical thinking over following strict rules, and value delivery

over busy work. We need you to explore existing or new technologies that creates value for our

organization.


JOB QUALIFICATION – MUST HAVE:

> Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience in

Technology Operations

> 7+ years’ experience in Linux System Administration of physical and virtualized servers (VMWare

and Nutanix).

> 5+ years’ experience in Windows Administration of physical and virtualized servers

> 4+ years’ experience developing with AWS technologies (EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, API Gateway, Cloud

Front) and/or Azure services.

> Strong problem-solving skills, able to troubleshoot and identify root causes to problems.

> Experience with observability, monitoring and alerting tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Nagios,

Zabbix, Splunk, Splunk on-call, AWS CloudWatch)

> Demonstrated ability to manage deployments in the cloud (Terraform, CloudFormation) or data

centers (Puppet, Vagrant, Artifactory, Jenkins, Chef, Ansible).

> Advanced scripting skills (Bash, Python and PowerShell).

> Understanding and acceptance of Agile software development practices.

> Familiarity with repositories (Artifactory, Bitbucket, GitLab).

> Understanding and acceptance that simplicity of our solutions is of utmost importance, this is a

pivotal philosophy at Leonardo.


PREFERRED SKILLS - BONUS:

> Previous experience with enterprise data integration solutions on hybrid (on-prem and cloud)

environments.

> Experienced with AI transformation initiatives including process automation.

> Previous exposure to workflow automation and AI agentic platforms such as Microsoft Power

Automate, n8n, etc.

> Experience with Data Lakehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics) and Data

Visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) solutions.


COMPETENCIES

> Problem Solving

> Teamwork

> Communication skills

> Customer Focus

> Time Management

> Action Oriented

> Planning

> Self-Development


Hiring Process


  • Application via LinkedIn, sending resume in English
  • Screening with Recruiter for 30 minutes
  • 1.5h interview with DevOps Team lead and Vp of Technology
  • Paperwork & job offer

title: Desenvolvedor PHP 5.6 Puro (Vanilla PHP)
description:
Remoto | Contrato PJ ou Cooperado


Sobre a oportunidade


Buscamos um desenvolvedor com experiência real em PHP 5.6 Puro, capaz de trabalhar em sistemas complexos, segurança de aplicação e integrações distribuídas.

Aqui não há frameworks, atalhos ou camadas desnecessárias, apenas código limpo, previsível e de alta performance.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações em PHP 5.6 Puro, dentro de uma base de código estruturada e madura.
  • Implementar autenticação, controle de acesso e integrações seguras entre serviços.
  • Trabalhar com mensageria e comunicação assíncrona.
  • Garantir performance de banco de dados e estabilidade das aplicações.
  • Colaborar com Vue.js no front-end e Node.js em serviços complementares.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com PHP 5.6 Puro em sistemas críticos e de larga escala.
  • Capacidade de atuar com arquitetura modular, boas práticas de código e padrões de projeto.
  • Vivência com mensageria (RabbitMQ ou similar).
  • Experiência com autenticação distribuída e segurança de APIs.
  • Domínio de SQL e otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com Vue.js e integração com Node.js.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com infraestrutura segura e pipelines de entrega contínua.
  • Capacidade de padronizar e revisar código de outros desenvolvedores.
  • Vivência em ambientes auditáveis e com requisitos de segurança elevados.


Se você se identificou com esse descritivo. Queremos conhecer você!

  • Domínio de React: hooks, estado, componentização e performance
  • Forte base em JavaScript Vanilla: DOM, eventos e consumo de APIs sem frameworks
  • Experiência com Git
  • Boa comunicação e perfil colaborativo

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.

title: Senior Software Engineer  (PHP and WordPress)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience and deep WordPress expertise to design, build, and maintain scalable, high-quality web applications and platforms. The role focuses on advanced WordPress development, including custom plugin development, hooks/APIs, and database optimization, while leveraging modern PHP and JavaScript practices.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for solving complex engineering problems, improving performance and architecture, and ensuring that all code meets defined quality standards. Working closely with product, UX, and front-end teams, translating designs into performant, accessible, and secure user experiences while integrating WordPress with external systems, databases, and services.

As a senior engineer, you will serve as a subject-matter expert in WordPress and modern web technologies, enforce development standards, and mentor junior engineers on WordPress best practices, scalable architecture, and maintainable code design.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress plugins using WordPress hooks, APIs, and database architecture
  • Implement and extend WordPress functionality while ensuring performance, security, and scalability
  • Develop server-side functionality using PHP and modern PHP frameworks/libraries such as Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symfony, and Doctrine
  • Collaborate on front-end development using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and frameworks such as React and/or Angular
  • Design and implement scalable application architectures, including lar-specific architecture and scalability considerations
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests for PHP and WordPress-based applications, including automated test suites, coverage thresholds, and CI/CD integration.
  • Ensure accessibility standards, security best practices, and compliance across applications
  • Implement secure user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Design, query, and optimize SQL and NoSQL databases in support of WordPress-driven applications


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Experience in WordPress plug-in development, WordPress hooks/APIs, WordPress Databases
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks/libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symfony, Doctrine)
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns and architectural principles (including MVC), front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, LAR), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design and deployment, and authentication and authorization across distributed systems and environments.
  • Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases and their declarative query pages with relation to WordPress
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git, GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with static analysis, code quality, and testing tools used to enforce coding standards, architectural rules, and test coverage (e.g., PHP static analysis, linting, and coverage reporting tools)
  • Experience with Nginix or Apache
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud providers
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits
  • Experience with JavaScript/React in relation to Gutenberg


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
