• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Generative AI Engineer / AI & ML Specialist

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in building production-grade solutions, implementing end-to-end Generative AI projects, and working across cloud ecosystems.

• Design and implement Generative AI applications using advanced methodologies such as RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, and fine-tuning.

• Integrate agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI) into AI workflows.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure API integration, test automation, and adherence to software engineering best practices.

• Optimize applications for scalability and performance in cloud environments.


Required Skills & Experience

• 6–8 years of experience in AI/ML and Data Science, including 2+ years in Generative AI projects.

• Strong proficiency in Python and frameworks such as Flask and FastAPI.

• Hands-on experience with deep learning, TensorFlow, and NLP techniques.

• Expertise in cloud AI services, preferably GCP Vertex AI, and familiarity with Vertex AI Vector Search, Gemini, Cloud Run, and Cloud SQL.

• Experience with agent-based frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph.

• Solid understanding of API integration, test automation, and software engineering principles.

• Excellent teamwork and communication skills.


Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

• Proven ability to deliver end-to-end Generative AI solutions in production environments.

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
COMPANY Infobase IT –


Requisitos básicos - DevOps Engineer II – Necessário inglês fluente. Pode estar em qualquer lugar do Brasil e prestará serviços para um cliente da inudstria de turismo e hotelaria, no Canadá seguindo o fuso-horário EST/EDT. Descrição em inglês abaixo. Oportunidades para brasileiros que estão no Brasil ou que possam ter contratos via Brasil.


Faixa Salarial PJ: R$17000 a R$20000 / CLT : R$10000 a R$12000


POSITION


As a DevOps Engineer II, you will be responsible for the infrastructure (on-premises &cloud) supporting all our client´s business applications. You will part of a team with a customer-centric approach and that follows the principles of “Spry – Lean & Simple Technology”. We strongly believe that complexity is the worst enemy and solutions should not be more complicated than the problem they solve.


The role will be working closely with other system administrators, development team and other

stakeholders across the organization. You will be part of the critical incident response team, the on-call rotation team that make sure our infrastructure is always available to our customers 24x7x365


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Overall: Be an integral part of the DevOps and IT Operations Team by managing the infrastructure that support our clients. Reporting to the DevOps Team Lead, the core responsibilities of the position are:


> Customer Satisfaction – As part of our Operations teams, it is everyone’s responsibility

to maintain the satisfaction of our customers by solving incidents in an effective and efficient

fashion, focused on identifying and fixing the root causes of problems. You will be part of an oncall

rotation schedule, requiring you to work flexible hours when necessary to ensure we

maintain our SLAs.

> 50%: Cloud and System Administration – Your primary responsibility is to maintain our

infrastructure (AWS and data centers), including the configuration, management,

troubleshooting, monitoring and/or upgrading of Windows and Linux servers across different

environments. You will be actively managing our applications deployments and will be working

closely with the Developers and Architects in understanding upcoming infrastructure needs.

> 30% Security – While operating our systems, you will ensure the highest level of security and

uptime, taking a proactive approach in identifying and managing cyber risks. You will actively

contribute to improve the Security of our systems by identifying, assessing and remediating any

security vulnerability that could exist. This includes creating, reviewing and modifying SCP and

IAM Policies in AWS, ACLs in firewall solutions, Windows and Linux security settings, among

other technologies.

> 15% AI Adoption – We believe that AI is a set of technologies that empower teams to increase

process efficiency and to offer new product offerings to our clients. Part of your role is to

identify opportunities where AI could help us scale up the value and the positive impact of our

solutions, while ensuring the quality and positive ROI of new tools implemented.

> 5% Learning and Exploring – Everyone in our team is actively Learning on the job every single

day. You are expected to thrive in a dynamic environment where new challenges are

opportunities to learn more about our solutions, customers, and the industry. We value

creativity over strict processes, critical thinking over following strict rules, and value delivery

over busy work. We need you to explore existing or new technologies that creates value for our

organization.


JOB QUALIFICATION – MUST HAVE:

> Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience in

Technology Operations

> 7+ years’ experience in Linux System Administration of physical and virtualized servers (VMWare

and Nutanix).

> 5+ years’ experience in Windows Administration of physical and virtualized servers

> 4+ years’ experience developing with AWS technologies (EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, API Gateway, Cloud

Front) and/or Azure services.

> Strong problem-solving skills, able to troubleshoot and identify root causes to problems.

> Experience with observability, monitoring and alerting tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Nagios,

Zabbix, Splunk, Splunk on-call, AWS CloudWatch)

> Demonstrated ability to manage deployments in the cloud (Terraform, CloudFormation) or data

centers (Puppet, Vagrant, Artifactory, Jenkins, Chef, Ansible).

> Advanced scripting skills (Bash, Python and PowerShell).

> Understanding and acceptance of Agile software development practices.

> Familiarity with repositories (Artifactory, Bitbucket, GitLab).

> Understanding and acceptance that simplicity of our solutions is of utmost importance, this is a

pivotal philosophy at Leonardo.


PREFERRED SKILLS - BONUS:

> Previous experience with enterprise data integration solutions on hybrid (on-prem and cloud)

environments.

> Experienced with AI transformation initiatives including process automation.

> Previous exposure to workflow automation and AI agentic platforms such as Microsoft Power

Automate, n8n, etc.

> Experience with Data Lakehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics) and Data

Visualization (PowerBI, Tableau) solutions.


COMPETENCIES

> Problem Solving

> Teamwork

> Communication skills

> Customer Focus

> Time Management

> Action Oriented

> Planning

> Self-Development


Hiring Process


  • Application via LinkedIn, sending resume in English
  • Screening with Recruiter for 30 minutes
  • 1.5h interview with DevOps Team lead and Vp of Technology
  • Paperwork & job offer

title: Python Back End Developer
description:
Python Backend Engineer

Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Mid-Senior

Key Responsibilities

• Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.

• Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.

• Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.

• Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.

• Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.

• Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.

• Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

• YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.

• Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.

• Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.

• Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.

• Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.

• Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.

• Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.

• Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

• Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.

• Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).

• CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).

• Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).

• Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

• Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.

• Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

title: Data Specialist
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We currently have 90+ Data team members who create and maintain our data products and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. While nearly everyone enters the Data Specialist position at the same level, starting compensation is based on years of relevant experience. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with frequent opportunities to grow compensation and achieve promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


In this role, you will:

  • Be the primary owner of high-impact work such as running or building new data products end-to-end, running centralized data ingestion pipelines that the broader Data team relies on, or building clean granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and the datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Become a trusted and reliable resource for our internal stakeholders or clients and work with them to identify and answer their key questions. You’ll gain insight into how investors use data in their investment decisions by contributing to data feeds, custom analysis, or data reports that are consumed by the top investors in the world. If you join one of our Central Data teams, you’ll also learn how our data drives decision-making at some of the largest companies in the world.
  • Improve our products, data pipelines, or data feeds by developing entirely new methodologies and features for our products, exploring and scaling use across the data team of new third-party datasets, or creating new modules to make our raw feeds data experience better. We value self-improvement and experimentation and expect you to enhance the products, pipelines, or data feeds that you own.
  • Learn or sharpen existing SQL and Python skills starting with our two-month new hire training program that will teach you SQL, PySpark, and Python fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality and want to ensure our products are the best in the world
  • You have strong attention to detail
  • You are a methodical problem-solver
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible
  • You have an ability to manage multiple priorities
  • You are experimental and curious – you aren’t afraid of changing the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.


For You:

  • You’ll work with a New York-based team
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

description:

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer


We are looking for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability stack, and platform operations. You will work closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure reliable delivery, stability, and scalability of our systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI.
  • Manage and evolve our GitOps workflows using FluxCD for Kubernetes deployments.
  • Maintain and enhance our Kubernetes clusters, ensuring reliability, security and scalability.
  • Develop automation tools and services using Python.
  • Manage and support a wide range of open-source services.
  • Administer and secure secrets management using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise platform performance and reliability.
  • Work across teams to enhance observability, logging, and monitoring frameworks.
  • Manage and maintain Linux-based environments and infrastructure.
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting and support connectivity-related issues.
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices and automation-first culture.


Core Technical Skills

  • Proven track record with GitLab CI for CI/CD pipeline creation and maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps tooling, ideally FluxCD.
  • Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on Scripting experience with Python.
  • Experience with open-source services such as, Elastic stack, Prometheus & Alertmanager, Fluentd, Kafka, Consul.
  • Experience with Hashicorp Vault (policies, secrets engines, authentication methods).
  • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and container lifecycle management.
  • Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues (DNS, routing, firewall basics, TCP/IP) would be a positive.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - (SRE / DevOps) – Azure
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Você será parte de uma equipe de alta performance focada em garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura em nuvem global da empresa, com foco em Microsoft Azure . Atuará em um ambiente dinâmico, com equilíbrio entre projetos estratégicos em sprints quinzenais e suporte contínuo à infraestrutura produtiva , garantindo alta disponibilidade e segurança dos sistemas críticos.

Se você é apaixonado por automação, observabilidade, arquitetura em nuvem e tem experiência sólida em infraestrutura como código, esta é uma oportunidade para impactar diretamente na transformação digital de grandes clientes do mercado.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar, analisar e otimizar o desempenho da infraestrutura em Microsoft Azure (clusters, redes, serviços de dados e aplicações).
  • Desenvolver, manter e escalar infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform em ambientes multi-região.
  • Gerenciar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions , garantindo entregas rápidas e seguras.
  • Atuar no ciclo de incidentes em produção , incluindo triagem, análise de causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis), documentação e implementação de correções preventivas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para otimizar arquiteturas em nuvem , promovendo melhores práticas de escalabilidade, segurança e custo.
  • Administrar e monitorar serviços críticos como Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway e redes privadas (VNet, ExpressRoute) .
  • Gerenciar e integrar soluções de observabilidade com Datadog , criando dashboards personalizados, alertas e métricas para clusters e serviços em Azure.

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.

description:

A vaga é 100% remota e proporciona exposição direta a executivos norte-americanos, em um ambiente estruturado, orientado a processos e com trilha clara de crescimento.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração mensal de R$5.000 , com bônus adicionais baseados em performance.
  • Trabalho totalmente remoto, segunda a sexta-feira, das 13h às 22h BRT.
  • Contrato de longo prazo com equipes e clientes dos EUA.

  • Ambiente profissional organizado, focado em metas e previsibilidade.

  • Inglês avançado (C1) — comunicação verbal e escrita clara e natural.
  • Experiência de 1 a 3 anos em vendas B2B, prospecção outbound, SDR ou desenvolvimento de negócios.
  • Capacidade de conduzir conversas comerciais em inglês com executivos e decisores nos EUA.
  • Organização, disciplina, resiliência e conforto com metas e ritmo acelerado.
  • Perfil tech-savvy, orientado a dados e adaptável.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de vendas e CRMs (SPIN Selling, BANT, Salesforce, HubSpot).


Suas responsabilidades

  • Realizar prospecção outbound (cold calls, e-mails e outreach via LinkedIn) para geração de oportunidades B2B qualificadas.
  • Identificar necessidades do cliente, aplicar critérios de qualificação e registrar detalhes no CRM.
  • Gerenciar pipeline de leads e manter registros atualizados com consistência.
  • Agendar reuniões comerciais para executivos de vendas e contribuir com informações estratégicas.
  • Conduzir apresentações introdutórias quando necessário, com clareza e profissionalismo.

  • Manter um ritmo consistente de atividades e métricas, garantindo previsibilidade de resultados.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo ou LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Histórico comprovado de metas atingidas e consistência em performance.
  • Interesse em desenvolver carreira de longo prazo em operações comerciais dos EUA.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Notebook com processador i7 (ou equivalente) e 12GB+ RAM .
  • Dois monitores para rotina operacional.
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset profissional.
  • Ambiente silencioso e estruturado para trabalho remoto.


Construa sua carreira internacional!


Se você deseja atuar diretamente com o mercado dos EUA, desenvolver experiência executiva e crescer em um ambiente orientado a alta performance, evolução contínua e consistência, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

description:
Location: Brazil | Supporting CALA

Company : Intellicene

title: Especialista em Kafka & CDC (Debezium)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional especialista em Apache Kafka e Change Data Capture (CDC) com Debezium , para atuar na administração, operação e evolução de ambientes críticos de streaming de dados em produção. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade das plataformas de mensageria e CDC.


Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar ambientes Apache Kafka em produção , incluindo instalação, upgrades, expansão de clusters e troubleshooting.
  • Operar e otimizar clusters Kafka em ambientes Kubernetes , utilizando Operators como Strimzi ou Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK) .
  • Gerenciar e automatizar deploys, upgrades e configurações via CRDs .
  • Implementar e manter soluções de Change Data Capture (CDC) utilizando Debezium , normalmente integrado ao Kafka Connect .
  • Criar, configurar, ajustar (tuning) e monitorar conectores Debezium.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e operação do ecossistema Kafka, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de boas práticas de streaming e CDC.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo remoto no fuso horario de Portugal


Requisitos Técnicos – Kafka

  • Experiência prática sólida com Apache Kafka em produção .
  • Conhecimento de diferentes distribuições de Kafka:
  • Apache Kafka (open source)
  • Confluent Platform / Confluent Cloud
  • Kafka Operators (Strimzi, CFK)
  • Capacidade de avaliar vantagens e desvantagens entre as distribuições (lock-in, custos, features enterprise, etc.).
  • Domínio de conceitos fundamentais:
  • Partições
  • Replicação
  • Consumer Groups
  • Offsets
  • Experiência com Kafka em Kubernetes , incluindo operação via Operators.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade e operação :
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Confluent Control Center
  • Kafka UI ou similares


Requisitos Técnicos – Debezium e CDC

  • Experiência prática em Debezium como solução de CDC.
  • Atuação com Kafka Connect , incluindo:
  • Criação e configuração de conectores
  • Tuning de performance
  • Monitoramento e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento dos principais conectores Debezium:
  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server


Diferenciais

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: Data Specialist
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We currently have 90+ Data team members who create and maintain our data products and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. While nearly everyone enters the Data Specialist position at the same level, starting compensation is based on years of relevant experience. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with frequent opportunities to grow compensation and achieve promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


In this role, you will:

  • Be the primary owner of high-impact work such as running or building new data products end-to-end, running centralized data ingestion pipelines that the broader Data team relies on, or building clean granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and the datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Become a trusted and reliable resource for our internal stakeholders or clients and work with them to identify and answer their key questions. You’ll gain insight into how investors use data in their investment decisions by contributing to data feeds, custom analysis, or data reports that are consumed by the top investors in the world. If you join one of our Central Data teams, you’ll also learn how our data drives decision-making at some of the largest companies in the world.
  • Improve our products, data pipelines, or data feeds by developing entirely new methodologies and features for our products, exploring and scaling use across the data team of new third-party datasets, or creating new modules to make our raw feeds data experience better. We value self-improvement and experimentation and expect you to enhance the products, pipelines, or data feeds that you own.
  • Learn or sharpen existing SQL and Python skills starting with our two-month new hire training program that will teach you SQL, PySpark, and Python fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality and want to ensure our products are the best in the world
  • You have strong attention to detail
  • You are a methodical problem-solver
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible
  • You have an ability to manage multiple priorities
  • You are experimental and curious – you aren’t afraid of changing the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.


For You:

  • You’ll work with a New York-based team
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Gerente de projetos SAP sênior
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos Sênior para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de migração SAP ECC → S/4HANA, assumindo papel-chave na transformação digital da organização. Este(a) profissional será responsável por conduzir projetos de alta complexidade, garantindo a integração entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, o alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa e a entrega de resultados com qualidade, prazo e custo controlados.

É essencial que o candidato possua conhecimento técnico do ecossistema SAP, permitindo compreender impactos funcionais e tecnológicos, dialogar com equipes de migração de dados, Basis, funcionais (FI/MM/SD/BP) e arquitetos de soluções, além de garantir aderência às melhores práticas e metodologias de migração.


Atividades

  • Planejar, coordenar e liderar projetos de migração de alta complexidade no ecossistema SAP.
  • Atuar de forma próxima às equipes técnicas e funcionais, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em planos de execução viáveis.
  • Elaborar, controlar e atualizar cronograma, escopo, orçamento e plano de comunicação do projeto.
  • Planejar e supervisionar as estratégias de migração de dados, desde inventário, mapeamento, saneamento até cargas e validações finais.
  • Coordenar ciclos de conversão, testes integrados (SIT/UAT), cutover e estabilização pós-go live.
  • Identificar, monitorar e mitigar riscos e impactos de mudanças de escopo, assegurando compliance com premissas e restrições.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo alinhamento e comunicação executiva clara.
  • Garantir que o projeto seja executado dentro dos prazos, custos e qualidade definidos, reportando status para comitês e diretoria.
  • Produzir e consolidar documentações de acompanhamento, lições aprendidas e relatórios executivos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Superior completo em TI, Engenharias, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de projetos complexos, com ênfase em migração SAP ECC → SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento técnico do ecossistema SAP, incluindo módulos principais (FI, MM, SD, BP) e integração com áreas funcionais.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas e metodologias de migração SAP (SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW, SAP Data Services, BW/4HANA Transfer Cockpit).
  • Domínio da metodologia SAP Activate, incluindo suas fases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das estratégias de conversão: Brownfield, Greenfield e Bluefield.
  • Experiência em SAP ECC, incluindo entendimento de dados mestres, transacionais e processos críticos de negócio.
  • Certificação em gerenciamento de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP ou equivalentes).


Diferenciais

  • Certificações SAP Activate e/ou SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência prévia em programas de transformação digital envolvendo Data & Analytics, Cloud e Integração com Databricks/Azure/AWS.
  • Vivência em ambientes multinacionais, com comunicação em inglês avançado para reuniões e documentação.
  • Conhecimento em gestão financeira de projetos (FTEs, burn rate, CAPEX/OPEX).

title: Assessor comercial
description:
Assessor(a) de Atendimento Comercial B2C | Afetto Design


Presencial | São Paulo | CLT


A Afetto Design é uma startup do setor moveleiro em crescimento exponencial, criada para ir além do óbvio. Somos uma marca autoral de mobiliário infantil de alto padrão, reconhecida por desenvolver peças que atravessam fases, unem estética, funcionalidade e segurança, e entregam cuidado em cada detalhe — do design à experiência final do cliente.


Desde o início, nossa ambição sempre foi clara: mudar a lógica do mercado, elevar o padrão de qualidade e nos tornar top of mind no segmento. Em menos de dois anos de vida, já estamos entre as 5 maiores marcas do nosso mercado, resultado de visão estratégica, consistência e excelência na execução.


Esse crescimento é reflexo de inovação constante, cliente no centro das decisões, processos bem estruturados e produtos altamente desejados. Mas, acima de tudo, é sustentado por pessoas que entendem que vender bem também é cuidar — e que cada atendimento é uma oportunidade real de gerar impacto e resultado.


Sobre a posição | Assessor(a) de Atendimento Afetto (B2C)


Buscamos assessores(as) acima da média, com inteligência relacional, repertório emocional e fome de resultado.


Na Afetto, vendas são o centro do jogo. Nosso atendimento é consultivo, sofisticado e humano — mas o ciclo só se completa quando há decisão e fechamento. Aqui, não existe atendimento excelente sem conversão.


Você será o rosto da Afetto em cada contato, com papel decisivo na nossa expansão: transformar interesse em compra, dúvidas em segurança e comparação em escolha. Esperamos protagonismo, ritmo, organização e consistência. Se você gosta de metas, performance e crescimento, essa vaga é para você.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir atendimentos comerciais B2C com foco em conversão e fechamento ;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, ampliando ticket médio com soluções completas;
  • Dominar o portfólio Afetto para vender com segurança e autoridade;
  • Conduzir o cliente até a decisão com argumentação ética e follow-up estruturado;
  • Cumprir e superar metas de vendas e performance;
  • Manter organização do funil e qualidade em todas as etapas do atendimento.


Indicadores de Performance (KPIs)


  • Taxa de conversão de atendimentos em vendas;
  • Ticket médio por cliente;
  • Tempo e qualidade de follow-up ;
  • SLA de atendimento (tempo de resposta e retorno ao cliente);
  • Performance individual vs. metas comerciais mensais.


Requisitos


  • Comunicação verbal e escrita acima da média;
  • Forte argumentação comercial e influência ética;
  • Leitura refinada de pessoas e momentos de decisão;
  • Foco em metas, conversão e resultado ;
  • Organização, disciplina e senso de dono;
  • Segurança emocional para conduzir decisões e fechar ciclos.


Informações da vaga


  • Regime: CLT
  • Formato: Presencial
  • Local: São Paulo
  • Remuneração fixa + variável acima da média do mercado , atrelada à performance
  • Benefícios: VT + VR


Perfil Ideal

Na Afetto, vender bem é parte do cuidado. Buscamos pessoas que gostem de vendas , se responsabilizem por resultados e entendam que excelência só se completa quando o cliente decide comprar.


Candidate- se pelo LinkedIn Recruiter e venha crescer junto com uma marca que está redefinindo o mercado.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:

The Creative Project Manager orchestrates strategic brand and creative initiatives that drive institutional brand equity and enrollment outcomes while maintaining fiscal responsibility for project profitability and creative team accountability. This role combines project management expertise with creative strategy understanding to deliver compelling, measurable brand solutions within the higher education space and consistency across creative deliverables provided by Carnegie.

  • Strategic Project Leadership & Brand Outcome Management

  • Monitor creative resource allocation and make real-time adjustments to optimize team utilization and creative project efficiency
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to maintain accurate forecasting

We offer

description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The Creative Project Manager orchestrates strategic brand and creative initiatives that drive institutional brand equity and enrollment outcomes while maintaining fiscal responsibility for project profitability and creative team accountability. This role combines project management expertise with creative strategy understanding to deliver compelling, measurable brand solutions within the higher education space and consistency across creative deliverables provided by Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Leadership & Brand Outcome Management
  • Lead comprehensive project planning for brand and creative initiatives, establishing clear milestone maps that connect creative deliverables to client brand and enrollment objectives
  • Coordinate Subject Matter Expert (SME) resourcing across creative, content, multimedia, and brand strategy teams to optimize creative outcomes in partnership with Client Operations
  • Proactively assess and mitigate creative project risks, including resource constraints, approval bottlenecks, and brand compliance challenges, escalating issues to the Project Lead or Account Director to ensure proactive resolution and sustained client retention
  • Hold creative teams accountable for brand adherence, quality standards, and deliverable excellence through structured review processes
  • Financial Management & Resource Optimization
  • Track project revenue performance and burn rate to ensure creative projects remain profitable and within approved budgets
  • Monitor creative resource allocation and make real-time adjustments to optimize team utilization and creative project efficiency
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to maintain accurate forecasting
  • Cross-Solution Integration & Creative Workflow Leadership
  • Maintain strategic awareness of creative project integration points across solution project management campaigns to ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints
  • Collaborate with other solution PMs and the Project Lead to coordinate creative asset development timelines and shared brand resource requirements
  • Escalate creative integration challenges and brand compliance obstacles to Delivery Operations team for rapid resolution
  • Participate in cross-functional planning sessions to align creative initiatives with broader client marketing and brand strategies
  • Advanced Workflow Management & Quality Assurance
  • Manage Asana workflows for creative project management, including approval processes, version control, and comprehensive asset management systems
  • Implement and uphold creative quality assurance standards that exceed client brand expectations and industry benchmarks
  • Develop comprehensive creative brief and project documentation systems that ensure stakeholder alignment and creative accountability
  • Facilitate strategic client communications regarding creative strategy, brand development progress, and creative campaign performance insights


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Understanding of brand strategy, visual identity systems, and creative campaign development to guide strategic creative approaches
  • Proficiency with creative workflow management, brand guideline implementation, and creative quality control processes
  • Experience in project management methodologies with the ability to adapt approaches for diverse creative workflows and brand requirements
  • Advanced Asana administration, including creative-specific automation, approval workflows, and sophisticated asset management systems
  • Understanding of creative project P&L management and creative budget forecasting to maintain fiscal responsibility and profitability
  • Knowledge of multimedia production, content strategy, and cross-channel creative campaign coordination
  • Experience with brand performance measurement, creative testing methodologies, and brand equity assessment tools
  • Proven ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while maintaining brand consistency, quality standards, and team accountability
  • Strong collaborator, skilled at aligning strategists and creative teams, fostering open communication between platforms and specialists
  • Dexterity and wherewithal to effectively deal with campaign pivots, platform changes, and continuous optimization requirements
  • Demonstrates initiative and autonomy, effectively managing priorities while utilizing guidance and support when appropriate
  • Experience or interest in using AI tools, with a willingness to learn how AI can impact and appropriately enhance the client experience
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent life/work experience
  • 3-5 years of project management experience with increasing responsibility, including a minimum of 2 years in creative project management
  • Demonstrated experience managing brand, creative, or multimedia projects in professional services or higher education environments
  • Higher education or creative agency experience strongly preferred
  • PMP, Agile, or equivalent project management certification preferred


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
  • Domínio dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Power BI será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

Pacote Office avançado;
Power BI será um diferencial;
Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.

title: Gerente de Recursos Humanos
description:
No
Grupo Iberostar
estamos à procura de um profissional para atuar como
Gerente de Recursos Humanos
para se juntar à nossa equipe em
Praia do Forte (Bahia)
. Antes de saber mais sobre a vaga, achamos relevante compartilhar algumas informações sobre o Grupo Iberostar:
Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores).
Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca.
Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles.
Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).
Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)
Missão global da função:
Gerencia a equipe nas atividades referentes aos subsistemas de Recursos Humanos, responsável pelo planejamento, organização e gestão de Transporte Fretado, Benefícios, Programas de Reconhecimento, Programa de Estágio, Jovem Aprendiz e PCD, atração de talentos, cargos e salários, recrutamento e seleção, desenvolvimento de liderança, treinamento e desenvolvimento, gestão de conflitos, onboarding, análise de desligamentos, gestão de resultados por meio da elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho a fim de garantir a fluidez, padronização e adequação dos subprocessos, alinhado com os valores, visão e missão do Iberostar.
Quais serão suas principais funções?
Define estratégias gerais para atração de talentos, definindo os meios de comunicação mais adequados e redes de relacionamento, a fim de atrair candidatos para o processo seletivo.
Revisa se as solicitações de pessoal encaminhadas atendem às políticas e procedimentos do Iberostar, a fim de fundamentar pareceres à Diretoria sobre novas contratações.
Gerencia o preenchimento dos cargos vagos em tempo hábil, de acordo com a Política de Atração de Talentos.
Gerencia e elabora projeto de qualificação de mão-de-obra local visando maximizar a produtividade e a qualidade do atendimento ao hóspede.
Gerencia e acompanha o Programa de Estágio, verificando o cumprimento das atividades previstas no plano de estágio, estabelecendo relacionamento com o agente integrador, visando alcançar os objetivos do programa.
Gerencia e acompanha o Programa de Indução dos novos funcionários, a fim de facilitar a adaptação dos recém-contratados.
Atende os colaboradores em processo de desligamento, se necessário.
Analisa as justificativas apresentadas pelo gestor e possibilidades de reaproveitamento a fim de gerenciar o turnover da empresa.
Administra a estrutura de cargos e salários do Iberostar, sugerindo alterações salariais, a fim de oferecer condições necessárias para a definição de uma política de remuneração competitiva frente ao segmento.
Apoia a Gerência Executiva no desenvolvimento de normas e procedimentos que estabeleçam estruturas de cargos e salários equitativas e justas na organização, visando ampliar a flexibilidade de movimentação de pessoal.
Analisa a criação e/ou extinção de cargos, validando o complemento das Competências Específicas conforme práticas do mercado, políticas e normas do Iberostar, visando subsidiar os demais subsistemas de Recursos Humanos com as descrições atualizadas.
Gerencia, acompanha e orienta à equipe na elaboração do plano anual de treinamento de pessoal, realizando diagnóstico de necessidades de desenvolvimento de competências, propondo orçamento específico, a fim de submeter à aprovação da Diretoria.
Gerencia e acompanha as atividades de treinamento, confrontando capacitações com as atribuições e objetivos das áreas solicitantes, identificando resultados de aprendizagem e de desenvolvimento profissional, verificando o cumprimento das programações estabelecidas no plano anual, a fim de atender às necessidades de formação e desenvolvimento de competências.
Gerencia o processo de avaliação de desempenho da organização, acompanhando e interferindo em todas as fases do processo, a fim de obter resultados precisos e satisfatórios tanto para o colaborador como para a organização.
Desenvolve estratégias para melhoria do clima organizacional, identificando falhas e implantando inovações e processos motivacionais, visando à integração e alinhamento das ações dos colaboradores aos valores do Iberostar. Além de coordenar a aplicação da Pesquisa de Clima Global.
Desenvolve estratégias de Endomarketing, identificando oportunidades de engajamento dos colaboradores, definindo instrumentos e canais de comunicação, a fim de fazer com que a comunicação certa chegue de forma eficaz ao destinatário.
Define e acompanha as campanhas e ações internas de Recursos Humanos.
Gestiona e controla a operação e custos do Transporte Fretado.
Gestiona e controla o plano de benefícios para colaboradores.
Executa outras tarefas correlatas ao cargo, a critério do seu superior imediato.

Capacidade de Análise e Síntese

Planejamento Estratégico
Gestão de Custos

Trabalhar em um ambiente inspirador que aposta nas pessoas, nos valores e em um modelo de turismo responsável.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases .


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments.

  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability strategies in Azure SQL
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention
  • Own database cost management in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence throughout the application lifecycle


Software Development & Feature Delivery

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems
  • Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack
  • Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers


Azure Cloud & DevOps

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices using Azure DevOps
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost


Required Qualifications


Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of professional experience in C#/.NET software development
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency)


Technical Skills (Priority Order)

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including:

Advanced T-SQL

Stored procedures and query optimization

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis

Performance tuning and troubleshooting

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including:

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery

Performance monitoring and scaling

Cost and capacity management in Azure

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Bonus Points

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar)
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio
  • Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to own critical systems and influence architectural decisions
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.

  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.Js, JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.

Job Title: Senior SASE Network Engineer

Location: Latham

Duration: 1+ Year


Role Description:

The Senior Network Engineer, SASE will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for all SASE-related technologies, driving the network and security transformation from traditional, perimeter-based models to a secure, cloud-centric architecture. This role involves integrating core SASE components—such as SD-WAN, Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)—to deliver secure and high-performance access for all users, regardless of location. Join us to tackle challenging projects and make a direct impact on our core product while investing in your professional growth.


This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be located in Bengaluru, India. At Client, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Design and Architect highly available, scalable, and secure SASE solutions for complex, global, and hybrid-cloud network environments.
  • Lead the implementation and deployment of core SASE components, including SD-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), and DNS security solutions.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize security policies, routing, and traffic steering logic across the SASE platform to enforce a consistent security posture.
  • Evaluate and integrate new SASE-related technologies and features to maintain a state-of-the-art security and networking stack.
  • Drive Zero Trust principles by designing and implementing fine-grained, identity-centric access control policies (ZTNA).
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities using scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools to increase deployment speed and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Cyber Security teams to ensure SASE policies and configurations align with organizational security standards and compliance requirements (e.G., PCI, HIPAA, ISO).


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in network and/or security engineering, with at least 2 years focused on SASE or similar cloud security architectures.
  • Expert knowledge of SASE Framework and its core components (SD-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, FWaaS).
  • Extensive hands-on experience with major SASE vendor solutions (e.G., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks Prisma Access, Fortinet, Cisco/Meraki).
  • Deep understanding of Network Protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and IPsec VPNs.
  • Proficiency in Cloud Networking and security principles in one or more major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong Scripting and Automation skills (e.G., Python, Bash, Terraform, Ansible) for infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • Familiarity with Network Security concepts such as Next-Generation Firewalls, IDS/IPS, TLS inspection, and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)



Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Python, YAML
  • Jira, Confluence
  • Ansible automation

title: Programador ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa:Oni Learning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, Oni Learning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de Oni Learning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!Descrição do Cargo:Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.Qualificações:
Desenvolvimento em Ruby:Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
Design de Software:Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
Controle de Versão:Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
Trabalho em Equipe:Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
